memories.content: Each member has their own schedule, priorities, and views on the pet policy amendment. No member knows how many others will attend.

Sunmark housing cooperative's bylaws require a two-thirds turnout of all members to amend the pet policy. A special general meeting has been called for September 12, 2026, to vote on the amendment. The meeting will be held at a specific time and location known to all members. Members may attend in person or by proxy as permitted by the bylaws.
